title: Schwan’s Home Delivery Selects SmartSense by Digi Monitoring to Protect Critical Inventory Across Its Delivery Fleet and Depot Locations
summary: SmartSense sensors and software will collect and analyze more than 23 million monthly data points from 3,000 delivery trucks and 300 depot locations in a multiyear deal with the largest direct-to-home food delivery provider in the United States
